Docs.summary: An upgrade insight for a managed cluster: an on-demand readiness evaluation for an upgrade scope, produced by the generateUpgradeInsights action on the managed cluster and addressable by a server-generated name. The name identifies the scope and evaluated target — `controlPlane-<targetKubernetesVersion>` (for example `controlPlane-1.33.5`), `controlPlaneAndAgentPools-<targetKubernetesVersion>`, `agentPool-<agentPoolName>-<targetKubernetesVersion>` (for example `agentPool-nodepool1-1.33.5`), or `nodeImage-<agentPoolName>-<nodeImageVersion>` (for example `nodeImage-nodepool1-202607.01.0`). The node image segment contains only the numeric image version, while `properties.targetNodeImageVersion` returns the full image name. The resource itself is read-only: GET returns the stored evaluation and LIST returns the stored evaluations for the cluster. Evaluations are (re)generated via the managed cluster's generateUpgradeInsights action, whose response body is the same UpgradeInsight representation returned by GET.
